m0-context.title: Verify context and git status clean
m0-context.imperative: Read handoff; confirm handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, evidence, stop conditions). Run git status --porcelain src/ and confirm EMPTY (no feature edit).

postconditions.statement: handoff complete; git status src/ is empty (clean adapter)

m0-context.result: Handoff complete. git status src/ is empty — adapter is at reverted 23-feature production form. G2 control OOS baseline = 0.5868 confirmed from g2_numbers.json.

m1-setup-dirs.title: Create records_g3_wide dir and copy rh_2025 from records_g2_control
m1-setup-dirs.imperative: mkdir .agent-work/451/records_g3_wide; copy rh_2025.record.json and rh_2025.record.npz from records_g2_control into records_g3_wide (same rh as G2 control ensures shared-pairs set matches G2 exactly).

m2-retrain-wide.title: Wide-net (hidden_dim 384) retrain OOS (train 2018-2024, eval 2025, seed 0)
m2-retrain-wide.imperative: Run train-latent-power-module for driver_quali_power_from_race_weekend with --hidden-dim 384, --train-years 2018..2024, --eval-year 2025, --seed 0. FOREGROUND. Capture stdout. Use artifact-root .agent-work/451/scratch_runs --run-name g3_wide_oos. Do NOT edit src/.

postconditions.statement: latent_power_manifest.json exists in trained bundle dir under g3_wide_oos

constraints: no src edit; --seed 0; FOREGROUND; <=10 min; utf-8

m3-emit-rw.title: Emit rw_2025 record from trained bundle into records_g3_wide
m3-emit-rw.imperative: Find latent_power_manifest.json under g3_wide_oos, use its parent dir as --bundle. Run backtest-latent-power-module --emit-module-record --eval-year 2025 --module driver_quali_power_from_race_weekend --records-dir .agent-work/451/records_g3_wide.

m4-harness.title: Run diagnose_quali_same_pairs.py UNMODIFIED on records_g3_wide
m4-harness.imperative: Set QUALI_SAME_PAIRS_RECORDS_DIR=.agent-work/451/records_g3_wide, run scripts/diagnose_quali_same_pairs.py UNMODIFIED. Capture stdout. Extract rw_acc, ceiling, pairs for 2025.

postconditions.statement: harness prints rw / ceiling / pairs for 2025

m5-evidence.title: Write g3_numbers.json
m5-evidence.imperative: Write .agent-work/451/evidence/g3_numbers.json with keys wide_net (dict: hidden_dim, rw, ceiling, pairs, split), control_ref (0.5868), capacity_excluded (bool).

preconditions.statement: harness run completed with numbers captured

check.command: cd C:/Programs/f1Brainz-worktrees/cmdr-451 && PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 py -c "import json;d=json.load(open('.agent-work/451/evidence/g3_numbers.json'));print('wide_net' in d, d.get('capacity_excluded'))" 2>&1

m6-result.title: Write g3-implementer-result.md
m6-result.imperative: Write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT to .agent-work/451/evidence/g3-implementer-result.md. Include: wide-net rw vs control 0.5868, ceiling, pairs, capacity_excluded reasoning, files changed, git src/ clean confirmation, assumptions, stop conditions, workflow feedback.
